title: Velvety Bitter British Rye Bake
description: A rich and velvety dessert featuring British bitter beer, rye flour, and no eggs, perfect for a romantic evening.
instructions: Preheat a copper pot over a low heat on your stovetop, then add the butter and allow it to melt.
Add the rye flour and mix until it forms a crumbly mixture.
Gradually add the dark brown sugar and mix until well combined.
Pour in the bitter British beer and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the reconstituted egg substitute, espresso powder, and salt, and mix until fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture to the preheated copper pot and stir in the grated ginger.
Cook over a low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of grated ginger if desired.
Allow to cool completely before refrigerating for up to 3 days.
When ready to serve, reheat gently in a copper pot or oven until warm and gooey.
